This course will explore contemporary challenges and solutions to teaching and training adults around issues of race and racism in the United States.

We will examine and use dialogic, critical and adult learning frames and methods with a view to equipping educators for necessary, but potentially charged conversations in post- secondary learning spaces.

The goal of this course is to integrate pedagogical theory with practice to provide an introduction to college teaching.
